name: io.github.Aruon-AI/beacon
title: Aruon Beacon
description: Order Aruon Beacon for a website: AI assistants can read it, a person checks it.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The Aruon Beacon products offered today, with their prices in US dollars before tax (5% Texas sales tax on SaaS is added at checkout), each orderable one's crypto total, and the payment rails accepted now. Other products are quoted by a person: see https://beacon.aruon.ai/pricing.json.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Records an order request for a website's owner (the principal). Nothing is charged. While crypto is open for the contact_email, rail usdc_base answers an order_token, and no operator key is needed: start_crypto_payment is next. Otherwise, with a crypto rail, an approved operator gets a crypto quote (exact amount, address, 20-minute send window) next to the card link, or a hold that waits for a person or for the principal; every other request is answered pending_review and a person at Aruon reviews it. Without rail, or with rail "card", it is a card order. A person at Aruon checks the first order from a new agent operator or a new buyer before anything goes live; the payment service can also hold an order before it is quoted. Once quoted, a payment on Base can take about 20 minutes to finalise after the send. A person reviews first-time and large orders. Paying publishes nothing by itself: a person at Aruon reviews the build, and the site owner approves a preview before anything goes live.

sku.description: a sku from list_products with a crypto total

rail.description: card (the default, as with no rail): the website's card path, where an approved operator gets the product's checkout link for the site owner; this service itself answers a card order pending_review and a person at Aruon reviews it. Or one of list_products' rails

operator_id.description: your operator id, given by Aruon with your key

operator_key.description: your operator key, given by Aruon

contact.description: how a person at Aruon reaches the operator; required with a crypto rail

authorization_statement.description: the principal's authorisation of this agent, logged; required with a crypto rail

principal.description: the site owner's details for the payment service's intake (all optional here; what is still missing comes back in principal.missing)

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Whether Beacon can score a website and install on it, from the published platform list and Beacon's address rules. Nothing is fetched in this call: what can only be known from the site itself is answered "we will check it when we score it".

platform.description: what it is built on, if known, e.g. WordPress

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: With the order_token create_order gave: this order's status and its crypto block. Or with order_id and operator_key, for the operator whose key made the order: pending_review while a person has not approved the operator, else the payment service's order view (held and why, quoted and the quote, paid, expired or denied). Paid publishes nothing by itself.

tools.name: start_crypto_payment
tools.description: For an order token from create_order: files the payment details (rail usdc_base, billing address with a two-letter state for the US, the wallet the buyer pays from, role, acceptance) and Beacon emails a one-time code to the buyer's own inbox (the order's email address), never to the agent. Answers the order's status.

phone.description: the buyer's phone, if not given at create_order

accept.description: true only when the buyer has read and accepted the Terms of Service including Schedule C, the refund policy and the Privacy Policy (https://aruon.ai/terms-of-service, https://aruon.ai/privacy)

tools.name: confirm_crypto_payment
tools.description: For the code the buyer received: answers the quote, or the hold and who must act. The quote is an exact amount (price, 5% Texas sales tax and a small unique tail), a receive address and a 20-minute window to send it, from the wallet declared. The agent never pays: the buyer sends from their own wallet. Paying publishes nothing by itself: a person at Aruon reviews the build, and the site owner approves a preview before anything goes live.

tools.name: request_new_quote
tools.description: For an order token whose quote has expired: a fresh 20-minute quote, and the order's status read again.
